frozen_note: frozen after the drift stage (labels not read) and before the first fit; rank_features filled by the declared drift rule from artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/tuning_v7/drift_v7.json (univariate AUC 2023 / 2024: pair_age_days 0.867 / 0.879, type_rate_net_365d 0.686 / 0.603, type_rate_net_30d 0.619 / 0.540)
fixed_by: Head DS (user assigned modelling to Head DS); criteria, candidates and modes as given in the v7 task of 2026-09-27; the list of rank-normalised features is filled mechanically by the drift rule below, declared before the drift run
basis: docs/reviews/team-brainstorm-2026-09-27 (CONTEXT, ds-a-signal, ds-b-formulation); TUNING_V4/V5; EVALUATION.md (honest recall, decision 27.09.2026); step 1 diagnostics of v7 (artifacts/sensor-failure-v1/tuning_v7/diagnostics.json)
interpretation: registered loss of connection >= 2 s ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device); not a confirmed breakdown; alarm is not a confirmed failure
unit: one row per card = object x sensor type x local 00:00 (universe of model_labels_v5 cards); label = event of the pair in [t, t + D)

features.point_in_time: strictly before the 00:00 cutoff; p7h__events_365d equals the static list on every card (checked at build)

fold_note: embargo = horizon (fit cutoffs whose window crosses the end of a fit range are dropped); calibration and holdout are not read
fit_rows: evaluable cards (outcome positive or negative) of the fit ranges, all of them (no negative sampling); rows ordered by (issued_at, object_id, sensor_type)

P1.meaning: pair history only (a learned 'smart list') + sensor and system type

P3.meaning: P2 + context for fresh pairs + forecast window

P3-rank.meaning: P3 with the drifting features replaced by their percentile rank among the cards of the same issue day

window_columns: p7k__workdays_{D}d and p7k__holidays_{D}d of the model's own horizon only; season sin/cos for both

drift.rule: a numeric v7 feature of groups H/S/C/X drifts if its direction-free univariate AUC separating the fold's fit-year cards from the evaluation-year cards is >= 0.60 in either fold (all cards, labels not read); calendar K and categorical columns are never ranked

lightgbm.role: second family (the v6 environment of the worktree has LightGBM 4.7.0); the same sets, seeds, folds, modes and criterion; CatBoost stays the primary family
lightgbm.weights: balanced classes (sensor_failure_modeling.fit_weights with negative_weight = 1: no negative sample to undo)
lightgbm.categorical: cat__ columns as pandas categories of the fit rows
lightgbm.seeds: 17/18/19 as the LightGBM seed; without subsampling the seed changes only the row sample of bin construction

score: card score of a set = mean of the three seeds' probabilities (ensemble); per-seed points and spread are reported
fit_count: 4 sets x 3 seeds x 2 folds x 2 horizons = 48 CatBoost + 48 LightGBM
multiplicity: 4 sets x 2 families x 3 modes = 24 comparisons with the list: a single pass among them is weak evidence

modes.name: 7d fresh K3
modes.policy: rolling list with release, at most K open, window 7 days
modes.fresh: card eligible only if its pair has no event counted in [t - 7 d, t) (static-list rule; DS-B 'new risks'); recall over fresh events (no pair event in the 7 days before the event start)

modes.name: 7d K7
modes.policy: rolling list with release, at most 7 open, window 7 days

modes.name: 14d K12
modes.policy: rolling list with release, at most 12 open, window 14 days

criterion.better_than_statistics: per set and mode, all of: (1) card precision above the static list in each fold (2023 and 2024, points); (2) paired week-block bootstrap (400 replicates, seed 17) of precision set - list pooled over 2023-2024 with 95% lower bound > 0; (3) honest recall >= list honest recall - 0.02 (pooled)
criterion.honest_recall: an event counts only if a selected card of its pair is open when it starts (EVALUATION.md, decision 27.09.2026)
criterion.reported: object-block CI; per-year week-block CI; the same comparison with 'rank F2 + list' of v5 (F2 seed mean at 7 days, F2 s17 at 14 days); persistence, list + persistence and the greedy ceiling; per-seed points
criterion.not_a_release: a pass is a selection on the development folds; a final check needs its own pre-registration and a period not yet used

static_list: Правило без обучения: число событий пары объект × тип за прошлые 365 сут (ориентир v7).
persistence: Правило без обучения: давность последнего кандидата на каналах карточки.
list+persistence: Правило без обучения: среднее внутридневных рангов списка и persistence.
rank F2+list: rank F2 + list v5 (сохранённые оценки v5)
Среднее внутридневных рангов F2 v5 (7 сут — среднее трёх seed, 14 сут — seed 17) и списка; не новая модель.
ceiling: Жадный оракул, знающий будущие события; верхняя граница, не модель.

holdout: not read; 2025-07..2026-06 has already been used three times
